name: Charge at the second product
definition: Hold the price everyone compares fixed, and grow revenue per customer by attaching products priced against the same flow.

mechanism.summary: The core product creates a flow the customer already pays for, such as payments or seats. Each extra product is priced as a slice of that flow, so it can be bought without a new sale and without touching the headline price.

preconditions: The core product generates a measurable flow that add-ons can be priced against
The add-ons use data the core product already holds
Customers shop on the headline price, so keeping it fixed keeps them
failureModes: The effective rate drifts far above the headline and customers find out at renewal
Add-ons start to feel mandatory, and the stack reads as a tax
A rival bundles the add-ons into its base price and wins the comparison

antiPattern.name: Raise the headline
antiPattern.description: Raising the one number every customer compares invites the comparison. Moving price into less visible components avoids it, which is also why customers learn to distrust it.
